monthlyNote: Reduced-risk historical research benchmark, 2019–30 October 2026. Returns include floating P&L at completed four-hour closes and retain profits. Uses proportional transaction costs; IB minimum commissions are excluded. Live execution results and sizing are separate.
modelCostNote: Reduced-risk model · proportional cost assumption; IB minimum commissions excluded
basis: Historical strategy model; separate from actual broker executions.
equityConvention: Retained model equity, rebased to100; historical simulation with no external flows.
